{{Quote|Vape, cold one.|[[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]]|<ref name="SC">''[[X-Wing: Solo Command]]''</ref>}}
'''Ebla beer''' was an [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] beverage brewed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bonadan/Legends|Bonadan]] from [[Ebla grain]].<ref name="GSWU" /> It was sometimes sold in a bottle with an "E" on the side.<ref name="K2">[[Droids (1994) 2|''Droids'' (1994) 2]]</ref> The [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] drank Ebla beer at Bonadan [[Spaceport Southeast II]] while he and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] awaited the arrival of [[Zlarb/Legends|Zlarb]] around [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]].<ref name="HSR" /> [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[New Republic Starfighter Command/Legends|Starfighter Command]] [[Brevet]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Garik Loran]] had a mechanism installed in [[Vape]], his [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]], during his time with [[Wraith Squadron]]. When a group of keywords was spoken&mdash;specifically "Vape: cold one"&mdash;the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] would discharge a chilled bottle of Ebla beer.<ref name="WS" /> [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] was also aware of the modification, and used it to dispense chilled beer for himself, much to Loran's confusion as it should not have worked for anyone but himself.<ref name="SC" /> During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], Solo and his longtime [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] friend [[Roa]] drunk Ebla beer as a reminder of the old days.<ref name="HT">''[[The New Jedi Order: Agents of Chaos I: Hero's Trial]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
''[[Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are]]'' attributes the erroneously spelled "Elba system" to ''[[Han Solo's Revenge]]'', the original source of Ebla beer. The [[Wikipedia:Ebla Tablets|Ebla Tablets]] are a set of Ancient Sumerian stone tablets, which (among other information) recorded a set of beers that were made at the time, including one named after the city, Ebla.
